title: Standardized Smart Contract Libraries for Cardano

ms.promise:
・Conduct research on existing smart contract libraries and common use cases.
・Define the scope and requirements for the standardized libraries.
・Plan the frontend UI/UX design and backend architecture.
・Design the user interface for the libraries, focusing on usability and accessibility.
ms.criteria:
・Identification of common use cases for smart contracts.
・Identification of requirements and functionalities to be included in the libraries.
・Plan for the frontend UI/UX design, including wireframes or mockups, and the backend architecture.
・User interface design focusing on usability and accessibility.
ms.report:
・Analyzed libraries highlighting key features, use cases, and limitations. Doc
・Document outlining the scope and requirements. Doc
・Links to wireframes/mockups and a technical document for backend architecture: Link , Link
・Links to the UI designs. UI

ms.promise:
・Frontend Implementation: Implement the frontend UI/UX design, ensuring that it is user-friendly and responsive.
・Backend Development: Develop the backend infrastructure for the libraries, including API integration and data management.
・Implement functionality for deploying and interacting with smart contracts.
ms.criteria:
・The frontend UI/UX design is implemented as specified. The interface is user-friendly and responsive. 
・The backend infrastructure is developed, including API integration and data management.
・Functionality for deploying and interacting with smart contracts is implemented.
ms.report:
・Link to the github repo and video of the web. Github and Web
・API Documentation: Include documentation for the APIs. Doc
・Provide a demonstration or test results showing how the backend handles interactions with smart contracts. Test results

ms.promise:
・Design and develop the smart contract libraries for token creation and decentralized exchanges.
・Create comprehensive documentation for the libraries, including usage guidelines and examples.
・Ensure compatibility of the libraries with Cardano frameworks and development tools, including Plutus and Cabal, with a focus on testing and validation.
ms.criteria:
・Libraries are fully designed and developed to handle token creation and decentralized exchanges.
・Documentation is complete, including detailed usage guidelines and examples.
・Libraries are compatible with Cardano frameworks and tools, including Plutus and Cabal.
ms.report:
・Links to the code repository where the libraries are developed. Github
・Links of the comprehensive documentation, including usage guidelines and examples. Doc
・Video results from tests showing that libraries work with Cardano frameworks and tools like Plutus and Cabal. Video

ms.promise:
・Engage with the Cardano community to gather feedback on the libraries and promote their use.
・Provide ongoing maintenance and updates to the libraries to ensure compatibility with the latest Cardano protocols and standards.
・Monitor and address any issues or bugs that arise post-launch.
ms.criteria:
・Feedback is gathered from users regarding the libraries, with metrics including the number of library users and user interactions with our platform.
・Maintenance activities are documented, including version updates and changes made.
・known issues are addressed.
ms.report:
1. A detailed report and images showing the number of user interactions and feedback collected from the platform’s users.
2. Links to the code repository where the libraries are developed.
3. Links of the comprehensive documentation, including usage guidelines and examples.
4. Issue tracking system (e.g., GitHub Issues) with resolved issues documented.
